id./param/region/r011.pack|npc_ie.bxon|21ae: "If I see the rumored happiness-bringing mural, maybe I can find my own path...

id./param/region/r011.pack|npc_ie.bxon|21d3: "A-at this rate I'll dance myself to death... Hup, hustle!
id./param/region/r011.pack|npc_ie.bxon|21dd: "The villagers plan to start a new business using the dance the monster taught. Amazing... I couldn't do that.
id./param/region/r011.pack|npc_ie.bxon|22b3: "Oh, {var:1}. Chelon is about to go see his dad.
id./param/region/r011.pack|npc_ie.bxon|22bb: "If you like, {var:1}, please encourage Chelon too! He'll surely be glad!
id./param/region/r011.pack|npc_ie.bxon|29df: "I train in cooking as I travel the world. Call me a wandering cook.
id./param/region/r011.pack|npc_ie.bxon|29ea: "Seeking inspiration for a new dish, I came for Phnom Nonh's rainbow rock salt, the top memorable souvenir.
id./param/region/r011.pack|npc_ie.bxon|29fa: "But monsters now appear where the rainbow rock salt is found, so no one can fetch it.
id./param/region/r011.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2a08: "Hey, you look strong. Could you get me the rainbow rock salt, the phantom seasoning that gives bliss in one grain?
id./param/region/r011.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2a20: "I see... sorry. You looked strong, so I asked on a whim.
id./param/region/r011.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2a31: "Oh! You'll do it! The rainbow rock salt can be found in Sacred Spring Cave in Laguna di Gondolia.
id./param/region/r011.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2a3e: "The salt is near the cave's center, I hear. Search patiently.
id./param/region/r011.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2a49: "When you get it, bring it to me. Please, I'm counting on you!
id./param/region/r011.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2a64: "When you get it, bring it to me. Please, I'm counting on you!
id./param/region/r011.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2a59: "The rainbow rock salt can be found in Sacred Spring Cave in Laguna di Gondolia.
id./param/region/r011.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2a72: "Oh, it's you! Did you find the rainbow rock salt?
id./param/region/r011.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2a7a: "Hmm... I see. But I'm only more curious! Sorry, but keep at it till you find it!
id./param/region/r011.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2a96: "This is the rainbow rock salt? The color and shape aren't much different from ordinary rock salt. Let me taste it.
id./param/region/r011.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2aa3: "Oh! The sweetness within the saltiness?! Sour, bitter, spicy, astringent too... and umami wrapping them all!
id./param/region/r011.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2ab4: "What a complex, deep flavor! I see, seven tastes entwine, hence the name rainbow rock salt!
id./param/region/r011.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2abf: "This is truly an encounter with a new taste! A flavor forever carved into the heart as a memory!
id./param/region/r011.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2acd: "Once tasted, never forgotten. Maybe the monsters couldn't forget this taste and sought the rainbow rock salt too.
id./param/region/r011.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2add: "I'll surely never forget today, when I met this salt. It's thanks to you! Let me thank you!

tm.「もしよかったら {var:1}ちゃんも\n チェロンちゃんを 励ましてあげて！: "If you like, {var:1}, please encourage Chelon too! He'll surely be glad!
tm.「オレは 世界を旅しながら\n 料理の修行を 積んでいるんだ。\n 流れのコック: "I train in cooking as I travel the world. Call me a wandering cook.
tm.「新たな料理の インスピレーションが欲しくて\n 思い出に残るみやげ物 ナンバー: "Seeking inspiration for a new dish, I came for Phnom Nonh's rainbow rock salt, the top memorable souvenir.
tm.「ところが 今は 虹色岩塩を\n 入手できる場所に 魔物が出るようになり\n 誰: "But monsters now appear where the rainbow rock salt is found, so no one can fetch it.
tm.「なあ あんた ウデっぷしに自信ありそうだな。\n ひと粒なめただけで極楽気分と: "Hey, you look strong. Could you get me the rainbow rock salt, the phantom seasoning that gives bliss in one grain?
tm.「そうか……いや 悪いな。\n あんたが 強そうだったから\n つい 頼んじまっ: "I see... sorry. You looked strong, so I asked on a whim.
tm.「おお！ やってくれるんだな！\n 虹色岩塩は ダーハラ湿原にある\n 霊水の洞: "Oh! You'll do it! The rainbow rock salt can be found in Sacred Spring Cave in Laguna di Gondolia.
tm.「岩塩があるのは 洞くつの中央辺りだって話だ。\n 根気よく 探してくれよな。: "The salt is near the cave's center, I hear. Search patiently.
tm.「無事に 手に入ったら\n 俺の所まで 持ってきてくれ。\n よろしく 頼んだぞ: "When you get it, bring it to me. Please, I'm counting on you!
tm.「虹色岩塩は ダーハラ湿原にある\n 霊水の洞くつって場所で 入手できるらしい。: "The rainbow rock salt can be found in Sacred Spring Cave in Laguna di Gondolia.
tm.「おお あんたか！\n もしかして 虹色岩塩が 見つかったのか？: "Oh, it's you! Did you find the rainbow rock salt?
tm.「うーん……そうか。\n だが ますます 興味が わいてきたぞ！\n 悪いけど: "Hmm... I see. But I'm only more curious! Sorry, but keep at it till you find it!
tm.「これが 虹色岩塩なのか？ 色や形は\n 普通の岩塩と あまり違いがないようだが: "This is the rainbow rock salt? The color and shape aren't much different from ordinary rock salt. Let me taste it.
tm.「おおっ！ 塩味の中にある この甘味はっ！？\n 甘味だけじゃない！ 酸味も 苦: "Oh! The sweetness within the saltiness?! Sour, bitter, spicy, astringent too... and umami wrapping them all!
tm.「なんという 複雑で 深みのある味！\n なるほど ７つの味が からみあうから\: "What a complex, deep flavor! I see, seven tastes entwine, hence the name rainbow rock salt!
tm.「これは まさに新たな味との 出会い！\n まさしく 心の中に 思い出として\n: "This is truly an encounter with a new taste! A flavor forever carved into the heart as a memory!
tm.「一度 味わえば 絶対に忘れないような味だ。\n もしかすると 魔物も この味を: "Once tasted, never forgotten. Maybe the monsters couldn't forget this taste and sought the rainbow rock salt too.
tm.「オレも この岩塩に出会った\n 今日という日を きっと忘れないだろう。\n あ: "I'll surely never forget today, when I met this salt. It's thanks to you! Let me thank you!
